about.title: Local dirt work from Jeremy Lane
paragraphs: Lanes Excavation is owned and run by Jeremy Lane, and has been digging in Hood River and the Columbia Gorge for years.
From preparing a building site to running utilities, putting in septic systems and fixing drainage, we handle the dirt work that every project starts with.
Send us your project details any time and we'll get back to you with a free estimate.

estimate.title: Tell us about your project.
estimate.text: Send us your project details and we'll get back to you with a free estimate. No phone tag, no full voicemail box.
estimate.details_label: What do you need dug, built or fixed?
estimate.thanks: We got your request and will reach out soon about your estimate.

services.name: Site Preparation
services.blurb: Clearing, grading and prep for new homes, shops and additions.
services.intro: Every build starts with a well-prepared site. We clear, grade and get the ground ready.

services.name: Utilities & Sewer Lines
services.blurb: Trenching for water, power and sewer lines.
services.intro: We dig and backfill trenches for new utilities and replace failing sewer lines.

services.name: Septic Systems
services.blurb: New septic systems and drain fields.
services.intro: We install septic systems and drain fields for homes outside sewer service.

services.name: Drainage
services.blurb: Fix standing water, wet basements and runoff.
services.intro: Good drainage protects your home and land. We find where the water's going and fix it.

services.name: Driveways
services.intro: From a new driveway to fixing ruts and washouts, we build driveways that hold up to Gorge weather.

services.name: Stump Removal
services.blurb: Stumps dug out so you can build or landscape.
services.intro: We pull stumps and clean up the hole so the ground is ready for what's next.
